svg.aria-label: EvalBot architecture: event-driven healthcare-AI evaluation assistant
svg.title: EvalBot — event-driven microservice architecture
svg.desc: Browser client over SSE to a FastAPI gateway, an at-least-once event bus, an intent-routing orchestrator fanning out to SQLite, Qdrant and graph retrieval legs, then a streaming LLM service and a citation-guarding answer service, with an append-only event log, a hot-swap model registry, and an offline corpus build.

g.text: Healthcare-AI evaluation assistant · grounded in a 15,954-paper scoping corpus
RETRIEVAL → GENERATION → ANSWER · ONE CORRELATION ID PER TURN
OFFLINE · CORPUS BUILD, BATCH AND RESUMABLE
chat thread · markdown renderer · [n] markers → Sources panel (arXiv / PubMed / DOI) · checklist · export · About (MARS) · localStorage history
sendStream() consumes SSE meta → delta* → done on /api/chat/stream · sendMessage() JSON fallback · demo mode when API_URL is unset
or served by the gateway at :8080
models.yaml → models.db registry · profiles chat / judge / embed, re-read on every call
POST /api/admin/profiles/{name} → verify the slug against the provider /models → publish model.changed
verification fails ⇒ previous profile kept · X-Model-Profile A/B · GET /api/admin/models · /api/admin/health
Redis Streams: consumer groups · XACK · pending reclaim · replay by id (podman :6379) · MONOLITH=1 and tests: the in-memory bus, same ack and fan-out semantics
Envelope Event{event_id, type, v:1, ts, correlation_id, causation_id, producer, deadline, payload} · dedupe on event_id: core/dedupe.py (Memory / Sqlite per service)
chat.requested → retrieval.requested → (sqlite|vector|graph|stats).result → retrieval.completed → generation.requested → llm.token* → llm.completed → answer.completed → *.failed
AGGREGATE → SQLite alone · FACETED → SQL filters + FTS5 · SEMANTIC → Qdrant · MULTIHOP → Cypher template · HYBRID → BM25 + dense + 1-hop graph → RRF k=60, dedupe by pmid → top-8
evidence assembly + a CORPUS STATS block the model must quote verbatim · guidance/sources.yaml answered by deterministic keyword/IDF, cited as type:web, never counted
turn grace-out on missing legs · meta{route, evidence_count, sources[], degraded[]} published before the first token · one correlation_id per turn
RETRIEVAL LEGS · ANY LEG DOWN ⇒ DEGRADED, THE ANSWER STILL RETURNS
papers.db — the only reader/writer · FTS5 BM25 · filters: year, journal, design, external validation
aggregate intent is answered in SQL alone: the model never does the arithmetic
Qdrant · EMBED_PROVIDER=hash (dim 256, dependency-free) or local EmbeddingGemma 2 / bge (dim 768)
payload-filtered ANN · dimension mismatch or missing store ⇒ vector.degraded, lexical legs continue
Neo4j + named Cypher templates — user text is only ever a parameter, never generated
no NEO4J_URI ⇒ LocalGraph over SQLite: co-authors, MeSH co-occurrence, journal rollup
incremental JSON decode · citation guard (drops sources outside the evidence) · marker renumber
markdown sanitize · schema validation → answer.completed {text, checklist, citations, markers, usage}
records the serving profile and model · finalises only on llm.completed for this correlation_id
final_merged_dataset.xlsx (15,954 papers) → data/papers.jsonl → data/papers.db → Qdrant index (+ optional Neo4j graph) · emits corpus.indexed
nothing in the request path reads the spreadsheet: the xlsx is a one-time build input, and ingest.verify prints the cross-store consistency table
answer.completed · SSE relay: meta → delta* → done
① – ⑧ = one turn: request in, tokens streamed out. Every hop is a bus event carrying the same correlation_id; the event log can replay the whole turn.

EvalBot · CMU–NIST AIMSEC / MARS (Model-Agnostic Rigorous Sandbox) · modules: core · retrieval · llm · services · ingest · guidance · 9 services + 1 ingest worker · buses: Redis Streams (podman) or MemoryBus (MONOLITH=1)
